title: Fix the worship case studies
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Written for islamic-studies/y8 lesson 24 (Pupil PDF worksheet: fix the worship case studies)
intro: Lesson 24: Worship and its conditions: purity and salah revisited. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

head: Case
Which condition fails? How to fix it
rows: Amir prays so that people will praise him.
Sara prays without wudu by mistake.
Someone adds a sixth daily prayer as an obligation.
Bilal prays on a dirty mat.
Someone knowingly prays facing the wrong way.

blocks.answers: 1. Ikhlas fails; pray for Allah alone. 2. Taharah (purification) fails; make wudu and repeat the prayer. 3. Following the Sunnah fails (bid'ah); keep to the five as taught. 4. A clean place is a condition; pray on a clean place. 5. Facing the qiblah fails; face the qiblah.

head: Ikhlas
Following the Sunnah
rows: The way the Prophet ﷺ did it

passage.title: Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, reported by Aishah (Muslim)
paras: Whoever does a deed that is not in accordance with our matter, it will be rejected.

keywords.def: doing the deed for Allah alone
following the Sunnah in how it is done
a condition that must be in place
purity of body, clothes and place
a new invented practice in worship

questions.q: Explain the two conditions for a deed to be accepted. (4 marks, our own question)
questions.a: Ikhlas: for Allah alone; following the Sunnah: in the way the Prophet ﷺ taught. Evidence 18:110 and 'it will be rejected' (Muslim).

questions.q: Fix the worship on the pupil PDF: five case studies (praying to be praised; praying without wudu by mistake; adding a sixth daily prayer; praying on a dirty mat; praying facing the wrong way knowingly). For each, which condition fails and how to fix it. Answer in the portal response box.
questions.a: Ikhlas; taharah, repeat after wudu; following the Sunnah (bid'ah); clean place; qiblah

questions.q: Extend: why does Islam have conditions at all?
questions.a: Worship belongs to Allah, so He decides how; it protects the religion from change

questions.q: Someone prays Fajr sincerely but before its time. What is missing?
questions.a: A) A condition: the time. Salah before its time is not valid; the time is a condition.

questions.q: Think again: what does the cake teach?
questions.a: Right intention and right way are both needed
